description: List contacts with pagination, returned in the HubSpot object shape.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return per page (1-100, default 10).

after.description: Optional pagination cursor (offset as a string) returned by a previous page.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a page object with 'results' (list of contact objects) and optional 'paging'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single contact by its id.

contact_id.description: The unique id of the contact.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the contact object; on failure (contact not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new contact from a HubSpot properties map.

properties.description: Optional map of contact property keys to values (firstname, lastname, email, phone, jobtitle, company, lifecyclestage). createdate/lastmodifieddate are set automatically.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created contact object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update properties of an existing contact by its id.

contact_id.description: The unique id of the contact to update.

properties.description: Optional map of contact property keys to new values. lastmodifieddate is updated automatically.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated contact object; on failure (contact not found), output contains an error message.

description: List companies with pagination, returned in the HubSpot object shape.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return per page (1-100, default 10).

after.description: Optional pagination cursor (offset as a string) returned by a previous page.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a page object with 'results' (list of company objects) and optional 'paging'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single company by its id.

company_id.description: The unique id of the company.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the company object; on failure (company not found), output contains an error message.

description: List deals with pagination, returned in the HubSpot object shape.

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return per page (1-100, default 10).

after.description: Optional pagination cursor (offset as a string) returned by a previous page.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a page object with 'results' (list of deal objects) and optional 'paging'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single deal by its id.

deal_id.description: The unique id of the deal.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the deal object; on failure (deal not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new deal from a HubSpot properties map, defaulting pipeline and dealstage.

properties.description: Optional map of deal property keys to values (dealname, pipeline, dealstage, amount, closedate, dealtype). pipeline defaults to 'default' and dealstage to 'appointmentscheduled'; createdate/lastmodifieddate are set automatically.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created deal object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update properties of an existing deal by its id, validating dealstage against the pipeline.

deal_id.description: The unique id of the deal to update.

properties.description: Optional map of deal property keys to new values. If 'dealstage' is set it must be a valid stage of the deal's pipeline. lastmodifieddate is updated automatically.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated deal object; on failure (deal not found or invalid stage), output contains an error message.

description: List all deal pipelines with their stages and metadata.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with 'results' (list of pipeline objects, each with id, label, displayOrder, and stages); on failure, output contains an error message.
